digest.component_or_area: metrics: event-derivation readers over durable ticket event store
propositions: Event-derived metrics for agent-process signals (attempts-per-ticket, first-pass-rate, rework-within-7/30-days, reopen-recovery, revert-recovery) require a hybrid read strategy: per-event data from raw event files (sorted, compaction-retired included) for multi-occurrence metrics, and terminal compiled state from reduce_ticket for single-value metrics.

Raw event readers must reuse existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key for chronological order, is_active_event for retired-event filtering, ticket-dir resolution) rather than reinventing file-listing and sorting logic.
Metrics returning None for empty ranges report Unavailable in the registry; populated ranges with zero qualifying events return measured 0 — the two outcomes are distinct and both asserted.
A ticket with two distinct claimed_session values in open→in_progress STATUS edges yields attempts_per_ticket==2; a single session yields 1.
A closed→open→closed transition 3 days apart is counted in rework_within_days(7) but not in a 10-day gap; both cases are asserted.

Revert-recovery counts tickets whose reverts target STATUS or COMMITS events (substantive reversions) but excludes reverts of COMMENT/LINK events; compaction-retired events (*.retired suffix) are included in all raw-event scans.
